description: wien.gv.at: electricity datasets is a collection of datasets listed in opendataportal.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by wien.gv.at. Coverage: the area served by wien.gv.at. The listing groups 11 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about electricity; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Wasserkraftanlagen der Stadt Wien; Tätigkeitsbericht 2022 Kompetenzzentrum Erneuerbare Energie Wien; Tätigkeitsbericht 2023 Beratungsservice Erneuerbare Energie Wien; Leistung von Windkraftanlagen Wien. Formats seen: CSV, PDF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.de). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-portal-austria.
